---
title: "Transfers & Breakout Stars"
subtitle: "Did Changing Colleges Actually Boost Hitting Between 2021 and 2022?"
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

b21 <- read_csv("batting2021.csv") |>
  add_count(Player) |>
  filter(n == 1L) |>
  select(-n)

b22 <- read_csv("batting2022.csv") |>
  add_count(Player) |>
  filter(n == 1L) |>
  select(-n)

both_years <- inner_join(b21, b22, by = "Player", suffix = c("_21", "_22")) |>
  mutate(
    Status = if_else(Team_21 != Team_22, "Transferred Schools (72)", "Same School (1,063)"),
    Transferred = Team_21 != Team_22,
    dOPS = round(OPS_22 - OPS_21, 3),
    dBA = round(BA_22 - BA_21, 3),
    dHR = HR_22 - HR_21
  )
```

With the rise of the NCAA transfer portal, it is easy to assume that switching colleges automatically unlocks bigger numbers at the plate. Across the **1,135 players** who recorded full Division I seasons in both 2021 and 2022, **72 switched Division I programs** while **1,063 stayed at the same college**.

The data tells a surprising two-part story:

1. **Transfers were already above-average hitters before leaving.** Players who changed schools averaged a **.847 OPS** in 2021—well ahead of the **.801 OPS** posted by players who stayed put.
2. **Changing jerseys wasn't an automatic boost—but the right fit created superstars.** On average, transfers gained just **+0.003 OPS** in 2022 (compared to **+0.016 OPS** for returning players), because many moved up into tougher pitching conferences. Yet when a transfer found the right lineup, the leap was dramatic: **KB Sides** transferred from Alabama to Arkansas and jumped from **0 home runs (.811 OPS)** to **13 home runs (1.212 OPS)**, while **Alyssa Brito** moved from Oregon to Oklahoma and climbed from **.936** to **1.190 OPS** (14 HRs).

## Interactive 2021 vs. 2022 OPS Comparison

Every dot **above the dashed diagonal line** improved her `OPS` from 2021 to 2022. Hover over any player to see her two-year stats, or **click a group in the legend** to isolate the 72 transfers!

```{r}
p_transfers <- both_years |>
  arrange(Transferred) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = OPS_21,
    y = OPS_22,
    color = Status,
    size = Transferred,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>", Player, "</b>",
      "<br>", if_else(Transferred, paste0(Team_21, " → ", Team_22), Team_22),
      "<br>2021 OPS: ", sprintf("%.3f", OPS_21), " (", HR_21, " HR, ", sprintf("%.3f", BA_21), " BA)",
      "<br>2022 OPS: ", sprintf("%.3f", OPS_22), " (", HR_22, " HR, ", sprintf("%.3f", BA_22), " BA)",
      "<br>Change in OPS: ", if_else(dOPS >= 0, paste0("+", sprintf("%.3f", dOPS)), sprintf("%.3f", dOPS))
    )
  )) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray45") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Same School (1,063)" = "#94a3b8",
      "Transferred Schools (72)" = "#dc2626"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1.8, `TRUE` = 3.0), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Year-over-Year Hitting: 2021 OPS vs. 2022 OPS",
    x = "2021 Season OPS",
    y = "2022 Season OPS"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p_transfers, tooltip = "text", height = 490) |>
  layout(
    title = list(font = list(size = 15.5), x = 0, xref = "paper"),
    margin = list(t = 60, b = 110, l = 70, r = 25),
    xaxis = list(automargin = TRUE, title = list(standoff = 14)),
    yaxis = list(automargin = TRUE, title = list(standoff = 12)),
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      y = -0.26
    )
  )
```

## Search Transfers & Biggest Breakout Hitters

Use the controls below to browse all **72 D1-to-D1 transfers**, see who made the biggest single-season `OPS` and home-run jumps across the country, or search for your favorite school.

```{r}
table_rows <- both_years |>
  filter(PA_21 >= 40, PA_22 >= 40) |>
  transmute(
    Player,
    Team21 = Team_21,
    Team22 = Team_22,
    Transferred,
    BA21 = BA_21,
    BA22 = BA_22,
    HR21 = HR_21,
    HR22 = HR_22,
    dHR,
    OPS21 = OPS_21,
    OPS22 = OPS_22,
    dOPS
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(dOPS))

transfer_json <- toJSON(table_rows, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE)

tagList(
  tags$div(
    class = "player-explorer-controls",
    tags$div(
      class = "player-control-group",
      tags$label(`for` = "tr-view", "Leaderboard View"),
      tags$select(
        id = "tr-view",
        tags$option(value = "transfers", "All D1 Transfers (Sorted by 2022 OPS)"),
        tags$option(value = "transfer_gain", "D1 Transfers: Biggest OPS Jump"),
        tags$option(value = "all_breakout", "All Players: Top 50 OPS Breakouts"),
        tags$option(value = "hr_jump", "All Players: Top 50 Home Run Jumps")
      )
    ),
    tags$div(
      class = "player-control-group",
      tags$label(`for` = "tr-search", "Filter by Player or College"),
      tags$input(
        id = "tr-search",
        type = "search",
        placeholder = "e.g. Arkansas, Oklahoma, KB Sides..."
      )
    )
  ),
  tags$div(id = "tr-count", class = "player-match-count"),
  tags$div(
    class = "player-card",
    tags$div(
      class = "player-stats-table-wrap",
      tags$table(
        class = "player-stats-table",
        tags$thead(
          tags$tr(
            tags$th("Player"),
            tags$th("2021 → 2022 College"),
            tags$th("'21 BA"),
            tags$th("'22 BA"),
            tags$th("'21 HR"),
            tags$th("'22 HR"),
            tags$th("HR +/-"),
            tags$th("'21 OPS"),
            tags$th("'22 OPS"),
            tags$th("OPS +/-")
          )
        ),
        tags$tbody(id = "tr-tbody")
      )
    )
  ),
  tags$script(id = "tr-data", type = "application/json", HTML(transfer_json)),
  tags$script(HTML("
    (function() {
      const rows = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('tr-data').textContent);
      const viewSel = document.getElementById('tr-view');
      const searchIn = document.getElementById('tr-search');
      const countEl = document.getElementById('tr-count');
      const tbody = document.getElementById('tr-tbody');

      function fmt3(x) { return Number(x).toFixed(3); }
      function fmtSigned(x, digits) {
        const v = Number(x);
        const s = digits > 0 ? v.toFixed(digits) : String(v);
        return v > 0 ? '+' + s : s;
      }

      function render() {
        const mode = viewSel.value;
        const q = searchIn.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        let list = rows.filter(r => {
          if ((mode === 'transfers' || mode === 'transfer_gain') && !r.Transferred) return false;
          if (!q) return true;
          return (r.Player + ' ' + r.Team21 + ' ' + r.Team22).toLowerCase().includes(q);
        });

        if (mode === 'transfers') {
          list.sort((a, b) => b.OPS22 - a.OPS22);
        } else if (mode === 'transfer_gain' || mode === 'all_breakout') {
          list.sort((a, b) => b.dOPS - a.dOPS);
          if (mode === 'all_breakout' && !q) list = list.slice(0, 50);
        } else if (mode === 'hr_jump') {
          list.sort((a, b) => b.dHR - a.dHR || b.HR22 - a.HR22);
          if (!q) list = list.slice(0, 50);
        }

        countEl.textContent = `Showing ${list.length} player${list.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} (min. 40 PA each season)`;

        tbody.innerHTML = list.map(r => {
          const schoolLabel = r.Transferred
            ? `<strong>${r.Team21} &rarr; ${r.Team22}</strong>`
            : `${r.Team22}`;
          const opsColor = r.dOPS > 0 ? '#15803d' : (r.dOPS < 0 ? '#b91c1c' : '#495057');
          const hrColor = r.dHR > 0 ? '#15803d' : (r.dHR < 0 ? '#b91c1c' : '#495057');
          return `<tr>
            <td>${r.Player}</td>
            <td style='text-align:left;'>${schoolLabel}</td>
            <td>${fmt3(r.BA21)}</td>
            <td>${fmt3(r.BA22)}</td>
            <td>${r.HR21}</td>
            <td>${r.HR22}</td>
            <td style='color:${hrColor};font-weight:600;'>${fmtSigned(r.dHR, 0)}</td>
            <td>${fmt3(r.OPS21)}</td>
            <td><strong>${fmt3(r.OPS22)}</strong></td>
            <td style='color:${opsColor};font-weight:700;'>${fmtSigned(r.dOPS, 3)}</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join('');
      }

      viewSel.addEventListener('change', render);
      searchIn.addEventListener('input', render);
      render();
    })();
  "))
)
```
